component.name: NRSC5 Studio
component.summary: HD Radio FM receiver and station explorer

description.p: NRSC5 Studio is a native desktop application for listening to HD Radio broadcasts on FM (87.5–108 MHz) using an RTL-SDR, SDRplay, or HackRF One software-defined radio. It is built around the open-source nrsc5 demodulator and the SoapySDR device layer, and adds a polished, persistent graphical front end on top.

ul.li: Full HD1–HD8 subchannel selection with a SIS-aware selector grid.
Now Playing pane with album art, station logo, and broadcast metadata.
Station Information pane surfacing the full SIS table — call sign, slogan, location, FCC facility ID, transmitter coordinates, per-subchannel program type and bit rate.
Rolling 8-hour album-art collage as a squarified-treemap heat map.
Live spectrum and waterfall scope, QPSK constellation, MER / BER signal-quality readout.
Closed-loop automatic gain control driving the active SDR for the best per-sideband MER.
TPEG traffic-tile decode and animated weather-radar overlay (iHeartMedia stations).
Persistent dock layout with dark and light themes.

description.p: The nrsc5 HD Radio decoder is statically linked into the binary; no separate helper installation is required. See /usr/share/doc/nrsc5-studio/linux-install.md for SDR driver setup and udev permissions.

libnrsc5 in-process cutover. NRSC5 Studio no longer ships and shells out to a separate nrsc5 child process — the decoder is dynamically linked against libnrsc5 and runs as a thread inside the app. The same plumbing now decodes up to four HD subchannels (HD1-HD4) in parallel from a single tune via a shared IQ fan-out. Fixes a Linux rtl_tcp GUI freeze on Start (bad host or wrong port now fails in ~5s instead of locking the GUI). The weather map base image (res/map.png) is now correctly installed by the .deb/.rpm at /usr/share/nrsc5-studio/res/. The shipped binary is now a combined work under GPL-3.0 (the project source remains MIT); COPYING.GPL-3.0 ships in the package and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md documents the corresponding source.

SDR transport refactor and Settings modal redesign. The [sdr] config models the data source as an explicit transport choice (LocalSoapy / SoapyRemote / rtl_tcp). The 0.2.x runtime fallback start paths (USB-direct and legacy rtl_tcp process launch) are removed; every Start goes through the same in-process piped IQ → spectrum → AGC → nrsc5 pipeline. Native rtl_tcp client implemented end-to-end in Rust at src/sdr/rtltcp.rs (no Soapy on the wire). 4-tab Settings modal (Connection / Gain / Display / Recording) with a transport picker and a transport-aware connection-string display. 1080p-friendly default dock layout; top bar wraps to a second line on narrow windows.

Closed-loop AGC overhaul. The host-side gain controller is rewritten around a Coarse-then-Fine search instead of the flat hill-climb that 0.3.x used. A new 7-day persistent gain cache lets the AGC skip the cold search entirely on stations you visit regularly. The settle gate moves from raw elapsed time to a sample-driven window (8 MER reports ≈ 2 s at nrsc5's 4 Hz cadence), so the first sample after a gain change can't contaminate the decision. A new agc-trace.log file is written next to the other app data on every tune for observability.

Tuner ergonomics release. Multi-input SDRplay RSPs (RSPduo, RSPdx) get an antenna picker in the Tuner panel, with the chosen input persisted across launches. The manual gain slider now applies live mid-stream instead of requiring a stream restart. No DSP / decoder behavior change versus 0.3.9 — both fixes are UI wiring on top of the same apply_agc_action and set_antenna paths the closed-loop AGC already uses.

Recording and packaging release. New 96 kbps Opus session recorder writes per-subchannel Ogg Opus files with Vorbis tags (artist, title, station). Supports time-based rotation. Default output folder is portable — next to the executable — and can be overridden. Linux .deb and .rpm packages return with proper desktop integration (hicolor icons, .desktop launcher, AppStream metainfo, manpage). Constellation lock no longer drops when switching subchannels. Theme accent color is now WCAG-AA contrast-compliant in light mode.
Light-theme polish and audio path cleanup leading into the recorder work.

Linux packaging debut. NRSC5 Studio is now distributed as .deb (Debian/Ubuntu) and .rpm (Fedora) packages alongside the existing Windows portable zip. No DSP or SDR behavior change versus 0.3.6 — this release adds packaging metadata, install scripts, AppStream metainfo, a .desktop launcher, hicolor icons, a manpage, and a first-launch dialog that walks the user through installing the upstream nrsc5 helper.
PSD release. Per-song ID3 metadata (Title, Artist, Album, Genre) now appears in its own table above the SIS table in the Station Information panel.
